ActorTalk: (Could this be connected to some kind of health tracker? Like a fitness band or sensor?)
Lee, has your frame been acting up lately? Or are you running some kind of test?
No...
You've hidden injuries before, remember?
Then I'll have to check you myself.
(Touch Lee's waist)
(Touch Lee's chest)
Mmh.
You'd better actually be examining me.
Avoiding it only proves you're hiding something, Lee.
Fine. Do what you want.
Pretty sure fooling around isn't part of standard examination protocol, [PlayerName].
And how long do you plan to keep touching me?
Just being thorough. Better double-check.
Then next time, I'll return the favor, with the same method.
Examination complete. See? No injuries anywhere.
Maybe you're hiding a micro detector somewhere...
(Inspect Lee's neck)
(Inspect Lee's hands)
You've got a pretty unique idea of where people hide things. What's next? My shoes? My hair?
See? Nothing on my hands or arms. Planning to search the rest of me too?
What more—[PlayerName]! Look out!
Good thing you're not hurt... ngh.
Even a small wound needs attention.
...Oh no.
Is that a comm from Liv?
Looks like Gray Raven's mandatory health screening has caught up to us.
Health screening? Wait, is it related to those numbers above your head?
You can see them? That explains your behavior just now.

It's a health monitoring system Liv asked me to test first. She said if the readings fluctuate too much, she'll have the entire Gray Raven squad checked to make sure everyone keeps an eye on their condition.
So what does this alarm mean then?
Probably because my frame data spiked too much. That's why Liv contacted us.
Think we can still sneak away before she finds us?
Too late. Let's go. Liv said you'd be the first on her priority list anyway. Consider it the consequence of your own actions.
I'll personally oversee your health monitoring. Hopefully that keeps you from needing another visit to the Star of Life anytime soon.
I'll be watching everything from your meals to your training. Step one starts with that little "examination" you just gave me.
It's just a scratch, don't look at me like that. I'm not that fragile, [PlayerName].
